word.definition: Fungible describes things, such as currency, goods, and commodities, that can be exchanged for something else of the same kind or value.

sports_fact.text: The largest blowout in NFL history is the 1940 championship: Bears 73, Washington 0. Washington had beaten the Bears three weeks earlier.

quote.text: Shakespeare's stage Must hold the glass to every age,— A thousand forms and passions glow Upon the world -wide canvas. So With larger scope our art we ply; And if the crown be harder won, Diviner rays around it run, With strains of fuller harmony .
quote.author: Francis Turner Palgrave
